**BookIt** — free, open-source e-reader that translates books into your language on your own device.

### Download
* **Android:** `BookIt-android-arm64.apk` works on most phones. If it doesn't install, use `BookIt-android.apk` (works on all). You may need to allow "Install unknown apps".
* **Windows 10/11:** `BookIt-Setup-x.y.z.exe` (installer) or `BookIt-windows-x64.zip` (unzip and run `bookit.exe`).

### What's inside
* 78,000+ free classics from Project Gutenberg, searchable offline, plus your own EPUB/TXT files
* Kindle-style reader: pages, themes, fonts, bookmarks, table of contents
* On-device translation into 90+ languages including 20 Indian languages (one-time 1.35 GB model download; then works offline)
* Switch between original and translation on the same page; export translations as EPUB

Translations are made by a machine translation model and may contain mistakes.
